text:
Good morning,

I am writing to inquire about hiring your Marlowe for a client event that we have scheduled. We will be collecting the vehicle on 25/05/2027 at 10.30am and returning it on 27th May 2027 at 6:00 pm. We would like to arrange for the Marlowe to be delivered to Brackenridge Manor and then collected from there after the event, accompanied by a chauffeur. 

I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Best regards,
Milo Larkmoor
